description:
Limiting Conditions
Download 1.0.0
Requires LazyLib
Requires MagicLib

Limiting Conditions seeks to make surveying more worthwhile and do-everything colonies less likely while sticking close to vanilla.

Beneficial market conditions like Cryovault have been added (with associated industries), the best resource deposits can be seen with only a preliminary survey, and various types of native population conditions have joined Decivilized. In turn, hazard ratings are generally higher, high grade resource deposits are extremely rare, and negative market conditions like Extreme Gravity get in your way. The core worlds have been (mostly) adjusted to reflect these changes.

A word of warning for fuel aficionados: while the new Domain Fuel Plant condition gives +1 supply to Fuel Production, without it supply does not grow with colony size.

This mod overrides vanilla's Fuel Production industry and is probably not compatible with any of the colony overhaul mods. Mod is feature complete.
